alt: Typed figure titled N-grams. For the sentence This is a sentence, N = 1 gives the unigrams this, is, a, sentence; N = 2 gives the bigrams this is, is a, a sentence; N = 3 gives the trigrams this is a, is a sentence.
author: Apurva Jadhav

alt: A language model predicts the next word. For the input The cat sat on the, the prediction is mat with probability 0.97, chair 0.02 and table 0.01.
author: Apurva Jadhav

alt: Slide text: a language model estimates the probability of a sequence of words P(w1, w2, ..., wn). For next-token prediction it estimates P(wt given w1, w2, ..., wt-1), where wt is the next token predicted from the preceding tokens.
author: Apurva Jadhav

alt: Handwritten definition: an N-gram is a continuous sequence of n words in a text. It is divided into unigram (an individual or one word) and bigram (a sequence of two words).
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten example corpus: The dog barks. The cat sleeps. The dog runs. The cat jumps. The vocabulary has 7 words, the total count of words is 12, and the unigram table gives The 4, dog 2, barks 1, cat 2, sleeps 1, runs 1, jumps 1.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten bigram formula P(B given A) = count(AB) divided by count(A), the bigram count over the unigram count. A table lists the six bigrams of the dog and cat corpus with counts (The dog 2, dog barks 1, The cat 2, cat sleeps 1, dog runs 1, cat jumps 1) and every probability works out to 0.5.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten question: the seven sentences <s> I am Sam </s>, <s> I like college </s>, <s> Do Sam like college </s>, <s> Sam I am </s>, <s> Do I like Sam </s>, <s> Do I like college </s> and <s> I do like Sam </s>; list all bigrams, compute conditional probabilities and predict the next word for like and Sam. author: NLP faculty

alt: Handwritten table of the 17 different bigrams of the Sam corpus with their counts and the sentences they come from, for example <s> I 3, I am 2, am Sam 1, Sam </s> 3, <s> Do 3, like college 3, I like 3, like Sam 2.
author: NLP faculty

alt: Typed worked solution for the corpus <s> I tell you to sleep and rest </s>, <s> I would like to sleep for an hour </s>, <s> Sleep helps one to relax </s>. It tokenizes, lists the 23 bigrams, counts them, computes the conditional probabilities (to sleep 2/3 = 0.667, to relax 1/3 = 0.333) and predicts sleep after to.
